notes: Basket air fryer; the iFixit guides cover the AF161, and its device page lists 1750 W and 120 V for the whole unit, not for any part. The basket and crisper plate come from the quick start guide for the AF160 Series, which iFixit says includes the AF161.

gaps: The 1750 W and 120 V figures are whole-unit values from iFixit's device page, so they are not put on any part.
Ninja's own rating label or spec page could not be opened (HTTP 403), so the device-page figures are not confirmed from Ninja.
The guide calls the heater a heating plate and also a heating element; its type (tube, plate or coil) and rating are not given, so none is claimed.
The fan motor is named only in the bracket guide; no motor type or rating is given, so none is claimed.

The ManualsLib copy is the AF160 Series quick start and does not name the AF161 in its text; the tie comes from iFixit's device page, which says the AF161 is part of the AF160 Series. ManualsLib lists the AF161 Owner's Manual separately.
The materials of the basket and crisper plate are not stated, so they are filed under sheet_metal only as the researcher's mapping.
The iFixit device page says the earlier AF160 had a metal base and the AF161 a plastic one.
method: iFixit fan replacement guide 159909 (Ninja AF161 Max XL), read via /api/2.0/guides/159909 and the guide page: heating element screw, fan under the heating element, second fan under the metal dome.
iFixit fan motor assembly bracket guide 159894, read via the guide page and API: the motor and the silver piece on top of it.
iFixit device page for the AF161 Max XL, read with WebFetch: 1750 W, 120 V, 'part of the AF160 Series with a model number of AF161'.
ManualsLib copy of the Ninja Max XL quick start (AF160 Series), read with WebFetch: crisper plate and basket named.

Refused: Ninja's AF161 product page on sharkninja.com (HTTP 403), the Ninja Canada owner's guide PDF (HTTP 403), an old Ninja support article (HTTP 403), and a Ninja US attachment that redirected to the support home page and was not followed. The old-support AF160 FAQ also returned HTTP 403.
A single news-snippet search for CPSC recalls of AF161, AF101 or Max XL air fryers found none, so no recall is recorded here.

comps.spec: Heating element (the guide also calls it the heating plate), held by one 1.4 cm screw; a 1.4 cm bolt behind the plate is removed first. The fan sits under it
Fan under the heating element that circulates warm air; it has sharp edges and is worked out from under the heater
Fan motor, held down by a silver piece on top of it (two 4.7 cm screws with washers); lifted out once that piece is off
Second fan under the metal dome, with two washers on top of it; it has sharp edges
Metal dome over the second fan, secured by one 1.4 cm screw; after it is lifted, a mounting screw and piece come off
Cooking basket, named in the AF160 Series quick start guide
Crisper plate, labelled in the quick start guide's parts diagram for the AF160 Series
